scope: Post-hoc explanation of frozen predictions; no retraining, calibration, or camera correction fitted.
reference_5s: First125 existing25Hz frames of each eligible original walk; same-frame-length diagnostic only; original RF trained on full walks.
distribution: Person-equal summaries; training-fold-only weighted scale for nearest-neighbor distances. Compare raw features and five-second RGB-derived cohort subset.
leaf: Exact bootstrap multiplicity times original person weight; reconstruct label/cohort composition in each leaf and assert leaf prediction equals weighted label mean.
path: Exact root-to-leaf value differences allocated to split feature; tree-order-dependent explanation, not causal importance.
limitations: HMR2 vs WHAM is confounded with people, population, acquisition and motion. Five paired people cannot identify clinical accuracy or estimator-only causal effects.
